title: Lab - Resource limits
description: Read, set and break resource requests and limits.
scenario: Read, set and break resource requests and limits. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Read them
tasks.instructions: What CPU and memory does the Pod rabbit request and limit?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Fix an OOMKilled Pod
tasks.instructions: Pod elephant keeps restarting. Raise its memory limit to 20Mi.
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pod elephant -o yaml > e.yaml
# limits.memory: 20Mi
kubectl replace --force -f e.yaml
tasks.verification: kubectl get pod elephant  # Running, restarts stop

tasks.title: Task 3 - LimitRange
tasks.instructions: Create a LimitRange in namespace dev with default CPU request 100m and limit 500m, then create a Pod and read its resources.
